US Officials Proceed with Smithsonian Arch Despite Historic Site Concerns

Federal officials in the United States have stated that a triumphal arch, part of an initiative associated with the Trump administration, will proceed despite acknowledged adverse effects on historic Smithsonian museum sites. The officials indicated that the project must move forward. The Washington Post reported on the administration's decision to proceed with the signs outside the museum.
